# Elettro Incorporated

> Elettro Incorporated is an independent web design, SEO, AI optimization, branding, video, audio, and digital production agency based in Davie, Florida. The studio has delivered digital work since 1998 for local businesses, hospitality groups, healthcare organizations, founders, artists, and established brands.

## Primary services
- [Web Design and Development](https://elettro.com/web-design/): Responsive websites, landing pages, conversion paths, technical implementation, accessibility, analytics, and launch support.
- [SEO and AI Optimization](https://elettro.com/seo-aio/): Search architecture, technical SEO, structured data, entity clarity, direct-answer content, internal links, and AI-discovery readiness.
- [AI Automation](https://elettro.com/ai-automation/): Practical workflow automation, lead routing, knowledge systems, content operations, and reporting integrations.
- [Video Production](https://elettro.com/video-production/): Strategy, capture, editing, motion graphics, short-form content, and campaign assets.
- [Branding and Graphic Design](https://elettro.com/branding-graphic-design/): Identity systems, creative direction, campaign design, and production assets.
- [Music and Audio Production](https://elettro.com/music-audio-production/): Original music, sonic branding, recording, editing, mixing, and mastering.
- [Website Redesign](https://elettro.com/website-redesign/): Content and design modernization, technical cleanup, SEO preservation, performance improvements, and relaunch planning.

## Industry experience
- [Industry Solutions](https://elettro.com/industries/): Selected industries and common project needs.
- [Hospitality Web Design](https://elettro.com/hospitality-web-design/): Websites and campaigns for hotels, restaurants, venues, and destination brands.
- [Healthcare Web Design](https://elettro.com/healthcare-web-design/): Clear, accessible websites and local search foundations for clinics, practices, and health organizations.
